t: The Feynman Safeguard: Bulletproofing Documentation with ASCII Art
s: A novel documentation system uses ASCII art embedded in GitHub READMEs as a single source of truth, ensuring consistency across websites and applications, with AI assisting in context recovery and system resilience.
sub: ASCII art as single source of truth for documentation
AI-assisted context recovery and 'banking wins' in Git commits
Feynman's engineering principle applied to prevent cascading documentation errors
Tiered documentation deployment: GitHub, website, and in-app
